description: WRITE tool — sets or clears the note on a tracked keyword in the caller's Sonar workspace (e.g. why it's tracked, an optimization hypothesis, a reminder). Idempotent: re-sending the same note is a no-op. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

note.description: Note text (max 1000 chars). Pass null or an empty string to clear the note.

tracked_keyword_id.description: Tracked-keyword UUID — the `id` (not keyword_id) returned by sonar_app_keywords or sonar_track_keywords.

name: sonar_update_keyword_note
title: Update Keyword Note
